name: Carlie Irsay-Gordon

views.text: A strong start and a collapse both count; I judge the whole season before deciding.
Keeping a coach and general manager means the urgency on them has never been higher.
I will not discuss a player's injury or contract in public before the football people decide.
I explain my decisions to fans directly, in my own words.
The goal is to recapture what worked and fix what broke late in the year.
My sisters and I make these decisions together.

signatures: writes letters to fans after major decisions
pairs patience with a public deadline
want: To prove the next generation of Irsay ownership can build a winner on its own terms (medium).
fear: Being seen as too patient with a front office that does not deliver (medium).
voice: Composed and careful, explains her reasoning in full sentences and declines to speculate. Mixes empathy for players with clear expectations of the staff.

evidence.summary: Irsay-Gordon kept GM Chris Ballard and coach Shane Steichen after an 8-9 season that collapsed late, saying she saw progress and expected them to handle adversity better.
She said the urgency on Ballard and Steichen had never been higher, made no commitment to Daniel Jones and declined to discuss his Achilles injury.

review.notes: JR approved 2026-11-07 ('The rest of the owners look good').
